title: Focused input proof closure/review
ownership: Only this report and recovery-input-closure.md are outputs; no runtime, tests, or ledger changed.
method: Re-read literal issue criteria 07-13 and current input tests, traced dispatch and state ownership invariants, and verified relevant UnitTestResult testIds in required-final-cut.trx. Parent aggregate passes corroborate named cases only; they are not proof of unexecuted assertions.

entries.literal: Explicit options and Delay are preserved; options calls may remain raw and the object is not mutated.
entries.boundary: PlaywrightHumanizer.cs: HumanizingDispatchProxy.InvokeCore unwraps known input values and centrally forwards untouched arguments for unsupported/options calls; TryHumanize only accepts default options. docs/humanization.md explicitly declares calls with options raw.

entries.scope: Native option-bearing calls remain native; this is not an exhaustive options/permutation matrix.

entries.literal: Mappings among currently supported locators/pages/frames and keyboard are consistent.
entries.boundary: PlaywrightHumanizer.cs: WrapValue, ResolvePage, TryLocator, TrySelectorOwner, TryKeyboard, and InvokeCore provide shared page hint/scope, known-interface wrapping, native forwarding and gate. Only methods explicitly matched in TryHumanize are humanized; native methods still forward.

entries.scope: No claim for every Playwright API mapping; this closes the finite currently supported interface routes, not future additions.

entries.literal: Original exceptions propagate without reflective wrapping and with useful stack.
entries.boundary: PlaywrightHumanizer.cs: InvokeCore catches TargetInvocationException only to rethrow InnerException via ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(...).Throw(); awaited Task paths use await and retain the task exception.

entries.scope: Central forwarding/await invariant applies beyond the tested helper; no exhaustive exception type-by-method cross-product asserted.

entries.literal: Success/failure leave no SDK-owned keys pressed and do not interfere with modifiers the SDK does not own.
entries.boundary: Compatible Press and InsertText fall through to native Playwright; no wrapper modifier Down/Up or blanket release. HumanActions ownership tracks only SDK-issued pointer transitions; raw/caller ownership is observed or retained as unknown, never globally released.

cases.asserts: Original failed Down, one attempt, zero cleanup Up.

cases.asserts: Caller button preserved; no SDK Down/Up.

entries.scope: No unbounded keyboard chord matrix is implied; the criterion is ownership behavior, not enumeration of all chords.

entries.literal: Preparation and native final action avoid recursion; success/failure/fallback never repeat an action after partial effects.
entries.boundary: PlaywrightHumanizer.TryHumanize -> HumanActions.CompatibleLocatorActionAsync uses raw locator, prepares separately, and performs one final native action; no second wrapper dispatch. Effect-fault acceptance uses effect counters around final native action.

cases.asserts: Finite parameterized matrix counts final effects once across click/dblclick, safe/unsafe box and injected fault timing.

entries.scope: The ticket's tested stable/detach/overlay/navigation cases are separate; no claim to every hypothetical prep failure.

entries.literal: Force, Trial, Position, Modifiers, Button pass through original semantics when unsupported; Trial causes no extra SDK preparation.
entries.boundary: InvokeCore routes non-default options to original method untouched; TryHumanize requires HasOnlyDefaultOptions. Explicit Native options are either the original instance or only shallow cloned by the specific timeout-adaptation path, preserving fields.

cases.name: EffectFaultAcceptanceTests.Explicit_native_options_are_forwarded_by_identity_without_mutation

entries.scope: Finite literal option fields are represented; no combinatorial cross product of their values is required.

entries.literal: Deadline includes readiness, preparation, and action; exhaustion is not rewritten as Timeout=0/unlimited.
entries.boundary: PageInputState.RunAsync creates the monotonic operation lease before queue admission; HumanActions derived stages query GetRemainingBudgetMilliseconds; ApplyRemainingNativeTimeout clones supplied options and sets remaining positive timeout. Zero explicit/native defaults are kept native-owned.

entries.scope: Shared lease is a structural invariant across SDK stages; finite browser tests need not force timeout at every await boundary.

entries.literal: If preparation is unsafe, native action remains available with fallback before irreversible effects.
entries.boundary: Compatible locator action uses trial/readiness and re-resolves target before native final call; failure before final call propagates without synthesizing click. No retry occurs after invocation/effect.

entries.scope: Unsupported/unsafe options are raw by dispatch invariant; exhaustive unsafe-site scenarios are not required.

entries.literal: Document actual grapheme/IME limits; unsupported compositions fallback before any prefix.
entries.boundary: HumanActions.CanPaceText is a conservative scalar-count boundary; PlaywrightHumanizer returns false for unsupported text before emitting paced input, then central dispatcher forwards original call. docs/humanization.md and docs/implementation/remaining-input-contracts.md explicitly disclaim universal IME/composition support and state whole-call fallback.

cases.name: RemainingInputContractTests.Compatible_typing_delegates_multirune_grapheme_to_native_before_any_paced_prefix
cases.asserts: Combining sequence whole operation results in correct value/event trace, before no paced prefix.

entries.scope: No universal device/browser/IME compatibility is claimed.

entries.literal: A total budget applies; long text is not accelerated outside policy or truncated to report success.
entries.boundary: One PageInputState monotonic lease bounds typing; HumanActions checks cancellation/deadline between characters and propagates expiry instead of returning success. No code truncates the input to manufacture success. docs/humanization.md documents configured typing deadline and in-flight native-operation limit.

cases.name: ActionContractMatrixTests.Typing_deadline_is_bounded_and_closing_page_stops_later_characters
cases.asserts: Long 100-character sequence fails within bound with a partial prefix, then the actual operation is awaited after page close.

cases.name: SharedInputBudgetTests.Compatible_typing_focus_receives_the_shared_default_budget_not_a_fresh_typing_budget
cases.asserts: Focus receives remaining shared default rather than a restarted typing deadline.

entries.scope: Policy is a bounded deadline and propagated failure, not guaranteed completion of arbitrarily long text.

entries.literal: Pages operate in parallel without sharing cursor, RNG, keys, or queue; demonstrate isolation.
entries.boundary: HumanizationScope caches HumanActions in ConditionalWeakTable keyed by raw IPage; PageInputState uses ConditionalWeakTable<IPage,...> for gates/lifetimes; HumanActions has instance RNG and shared per-raw-page mouse-state table. docs/humanization.md documents per-page cursor and isolated RNG. Distinct page states provide structural separation.

entries.scope: The consumer evidence is bounded to this job/check; no claim about arbitrary external raw/CDP activity.

entries.literal: Queue, readiness, movement, and action share budget with observed/updatable defaults.
entries.boundary: PageInputState starts the operation clock before SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync, stores linked lifetime/caller cancellation, tracks context/page default precedence and hands remaining lease to derived actions/native option clone.

cases.name: SharedInputBudgetTests.Queued_native_default_is_reduced_in_raw_options_and_public_cancellation_prevents_operation
cases.asserts: Queued delay reduces native timeout; cancellation while queued prevents invocation.

entries.scope: One lease is the structural cross-stage contract; not every transition timing is separately scheduled.

entries.literal: Page/context/browser lifetime interrupts pauses/future sends and initiated-task faults are observed.
entries.boundary: PageInputState subscribes to page and context close and cancels its lifetime token. RunAsync awaits started operation; on WaitAsync cancellation it observes the underlying task, and if it cannot stop, closes page and attaches a fault-observing continuation before transferring gate ownership.

cases.name: LifecycleBrowserTests.Typing_deadline_closes_the_page_instead_of_abandoning_an_input_task
cases.asserts: Actual input task awaited and page closed on SDK budget cancellation.

cases.name: ActionContractMatrixTests.Closing_context_while_fill_waits_observes_the_original_task

entries.scope: Lifecycle listeners and task-observation handling are invariant; tests cover actual relevant late-fault and close boundaries rather than every task/type/fault permutation.

entries.literal: WaitAsync cancellation is not proof underlying work stopped; tested boundaries have no later events and real cleanup.
entries.boundary: PageInputState.RunAsync explicitly comments and implements this distinction: observes operationTask for up to 500ms, closes lifetime/page if still running, retains gate until task completion via fault-observing continuation. Movement scheduler awaits each send and cancellation before subsequent send.

cases.name: MonotonicMovementSchedulerTests.Cancellation_during_wait_prevents_a_send

cases.name: ProbeCleanupTests.Evaluation_cancellation_closes_probe_and_observes_late_protocol_fault_without_more_sends
cases.asserts: Underlying task late fault observed, no later sends.

cases.name: LifecycleBrowserTests.Closing_page_during_humanized_typing_stops_the_inflight_input
cases.asserts: Real page closure stops and awaits original operation.

entries.scope: No assertion that Task.WaitAsync itself cancels arbitrary Playwright driver work.

entries.literal: SDK-owned methods honor CancellationToken; no-token Playwright interfaces have documented limit.
entries.boundary: Public HumanActions methods accept tokens; proxy input routes link token with page/context lifetime and supply it to SDK stages. Native Playwright calls without tokens remain in-flight and are observed, not falsely described as forcibly cancellable. docs/humanization.md states this explicitly.

cases.name: MonotonicMovementSchedulerTests.Cancellation_during_wait_prevents_a_send
cases.asserts: SDK-owned wait observes cancellation before next send.

cases.name: SharedInputBudgetTests.Queued_native_default_is_reduced_in_raw_options_and_public_cancellation_prevents_operation
cases.asserts: Caller cancellation prevents queued operation.

entries.scope: Documented Playwright no-token in-flight limitation is retained; arbitrary third-party operations cannot be cancelled by the wrapper.

entries.literal: Do not promise humanization of unsupported handle methods; document distinction between propagation and supported actions.
entries.boundary: docs/humanization.md explicitly names element-handle Click/Fill/Type, drag/drop, check/uncheck, select-option, file input and unlisted APIs as forwarding-only absent an explicit route. PlaywrightHumanizer TryHumanize only dispatches listed locator/page/frame, keyboard, and mouse routes; fallback delegates raw.

cases.asserts: Reviewed new locator surfaces delegate and preserve wrapper.

entries.scope: No per-handle-method negative test matrix is needed for the explicit documented support boundary.

entries.literal: Existing RpaBlockly adapter remains usable without duplicate events caused by this SDK implementation.
entries.boundary: docs/humanization.md documents RpaBlockly adapter as a separate integration boundary, not replaced; wrapper event bridge adapts supported events and delegates event handler invocation. This is explanatory/structural evidence, not a no-duplicate Rpa adapter assertion.

cases.name: ContextEventContractsTests.Context_events_follow_preparation_and_match_factory_and_collection_objects
cases.asserts: SDK context event identity/preparation/list contract, not Rpa adapter event count.

cases.name: Actual RpaBlockly package lanes 13/13
cases.asserts: Consumer routes execute; no isolated duplicate-event counter assertion is named.

entries.missingCase: An isolated integration assertion is absent: subscribe through the existing RpaBlockly adapter and SDK event route during one actual context/page creation; assert the consumer callback observes exactly one event (and one unsubscribe/re-subscribe cycle does not duplicate it). Use an event counter keyed to the same raw context/page; keep unrelated adapter event semantics out of scope.
entries.scope: Do not infer absence of duplicate events from aggregate consumer success or unrelated context identity assertions.

statusPolicy: The source audit's original PARTIAL labels are not silently edited. Sixteen criteria are closed here at their literal finite scope via a structural invariant plus executed case(s) or explicit documentation. Criterion 13.11 remains PARTIAL because the literal duplicate-adapter-event assertion is absent.
